newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yokohama mulls taking Nomura off bond underwriting.
newsitem.headline: Yokohama mulls taking Nomura off bond underwriting.

text.p: The city of Yokohama is considering removing Nomura Securities Co Ltd from its bond underwriting, an official for the city government said on Wednesday.
"Given the Ministry of Finance's (MOF) decision on Tuesday to suspend Nomura from Japanese government bond (JGB) underwriting, we are now considering taking a similar step," the official said.

The MOF said on Tuesday it would suspend Nomura from JGB auctions and JGB underwriting until the implementation of administrative punishment against the brokerage proposed by the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission (SESC).

Earlier on Tuesday the SESC filed complaints with prosecutors alleging that Nomura, Japan's biggest brokerage, and three of its three former executives illegally compensated a corporate client for losses. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-8570
